newsitem.title: USA: FDA seeks more study from Neopath.
newsitem.headline: FDA seeks more study from Neopath.

text.p: NeoPath Inc said on Friday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration Hematology and Pathology Devices Advisory Panel recommended not to approve at this time the supplement to the company's premarket approval submission for the use of the AutoPap System as a primary screener of Pap smear slides.

NeoPath said it was asked by the panel to present additional on-site data that the use of the AutoPap System as a primary screener of microscopic images from Pap smear slides is superior to the current standard of review by a cytotechnologist followed by qualtiy control reveiw.
